review_candidates.title: Platform Engineer – Kubernetes & GitOps (m/f/d)
review_candidates.description: Do you love taking on new challenges and want to help us pursue our mission to make digital communication in healthcare secure and reliable? Then we are looking for you as a Platform Engineer – Kubernetes & GitOps (m/f/d) to strengthen our team! Since our founding in 2019, Famedly has been working to digitize medical communication processes in a data-protection-compliant way and revolutionize the healthcare system. Famedly brought the first gematik-certified TI-Messenger to market to improve communication and collaboration within the healthcare sector. Famedly enables medical teams to exchange sensitive patient information, images, and other files in real time from anywhere — from medication plans and lab results to X-ray images. As a dynamic, remote-first startup based in Berlin with a growing and experienced team, we work together every day toward our vision of a healthcare system without information barriers. Famedly relies on open-source software and primarily uses and actively contributes to Matrix and FHIR. As a Platform Engineer – Kubernetes & GitOps (m/f/d) , you will be part of a talented team of developers at all levels and play a central role in building and operating the next generation of our infrastructure. We are actively migrating from an Ansible-based VM deployment model to a Kubernetes-based platform managed via GitOps . Our clusters are self-hosted and self-managed (bare metal and cloud VMs) - we deliberately do not use managed Kubernetes offerings. Your responsibilities Design, and build our Kubernetes platform across multiple self-hosted clusters Operate self-hosted Kubernetes clusters end to end: upgrades, CNI networking, storage, load balancing, and DNS Provision and lifecycle-manage infrastructure with OpenTofu and Terragrunt : writing and reviewing modules, state management, plan/apply workflows Develop and maintain our GitOps workflows with Argo CD (app-of-apps model, Helm-based deployments) Operate and evolve core platform services such as Harbor , OpenBao , Zitadel Build and improve observability across the platform (Grafana, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, Alloy) and contribute to actionable alerting Manage secrets, backups, and data services (e.g. CNPG/PostgreSQL , Barman ) Partner with product engineering teams to migrate services from Ansible/VM-based deployments to Kubernetes and define reusable deployment standards Improve developer experience through documentation, templates, golden paths, and self-service platform capabilities Troubleshoot platform issues across infrastructure, networking, and application layers (2nd-level support) Participate in on-call duties to ensure stable platform operations What you should bring Several years of experience in infrastructure engineering , platform engineering or DevOps Hands-on experience operating self-hosted/self-managed Kubernetes in production : cluster upgrades, networking, storage, and troubleshooting without relying on a cloud provider's managed control plane. Daily GitOps practice: you ship changes via Git pull requests and Argo CD (or Flux) reconciliation, with solid Git fundamentals (branching, reviews, rebasing) Experience with monitoring and observability for distributed systems (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus/Mimir, Loki) Scripting and automation skills (e.g. Nix , Bash ) Familiarity with CI/CD workflows and production deployment practices (progressive rollouts, rollbacks, health checks) Strong problem-solving skills, clear communication, and a proactive ownership mindset Very good English skills, written and spoken Nice to have Ideally a completed IT apprenticeship or degree — or equivalent qualifications through professional experience Experience with Talos Linux or other minimal/immutable Kubernetes operating systems Bare-metal operations: RAID/LVM storage, out-of-band access, hardware lifecycle Experience with secrets management (e.g. OpenBao/Vault , External Secrets Operator) Experience with PostgreSQL operators (e.g. CNPG ) and backup/restore workflows Prior involvement in large-scale infrastructure migrations Experience in regulated or security-sensitive environments Please note: For this position, we are currently only able to consider applications from candidates located within the EU/EEA. Why you should work at Famedly Work at a fast-growing startup in an exciting phase — Since 2019 we have grown rapidly and we have big plans ahead! Famedly brought the first gematik-certified TI-Messenger to market, and with your help we will continue to evolve it and the platform behind it. Your perfect work-life balance — With remote work and flexible hours, you decide when and where you are most productive. You also have the option to work from our office in Berlin. Your choice: set up your home office or use a co-working space! Attractive conditions — A permanent contract with competitive compensation (range between 60-70k € gross/year depending on your experience), a training budget, work equipment of your choice, and 28 vacation days per year. Flexible Benefits with Probonio – You receive a monthly wellbeing budget that you can use for vouchers from a wide range of food, mobility, retail, and lifestyle partners or for a discounted membership with Urban Sports Club. We love open source — In your work you will regularly have the opportunity to contribute to open-source projects. An overview is available at: github.com/famedly Autonomy & room to shape — At Famedly you make a difference. Help shape company structures and internal processes from the ground up and make your individual contribution. To advance our mission, every process is worth questioning and improving! A diverse and international team — We value an open mindset and a diverse, inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome. Regular team events — Workshops, team-building activities, virtual game nights, and company events such as our Summer and Winter Summit. We are a proud equal-opportunities employer and place great value on mutual tolerance and acceptance in a diverse environment. Everyone receives the same opportunities in our application process. We look forward to hearing from you! Sounds good? What are you waiting for? Apply now! We are excited to get to know you!
